text_block_list.text:
After watching the race, as I walked out 
through the entrance, I noticed an 
Umamusume clutching her head...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Aaargh, business is in the gutter~... At 
this rate, the future of Golshi-brand 
yakisoba is doomed, doooomed...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, you! Give me an idea for a 
V-shaped business turnaround right now!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Haaah... You really don't get it, do ya?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
If it gets any more delicious, every 
yakisoba stall in the whole universe is 
gonna go out of business, dammit!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Moderate quality makes people feel 
safer... Which means!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Nothing beats the natural flavor, after 
all! Woooo! I'm suddenly feeling totally 
fired up!

What truly matters, it seems, is one's 
determination.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The hell kinda choice is that?! Takoyaki 
was right there, ya bum!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Besides, if Golshi-chan starts selling 
anything other than yakisoba, it'll plunge 
the cosmic economy into chaos!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ...Well, it's not a bad angle, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
As thanks, I'll teach ya the most 
important secret to making takoyaki.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Listen up, rhythm is what counts. Start 
off delicate, and then accelerate all at 
once at the finish!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: You drop a beat too, yo!

Gentle at first, and then accelerating 
gradually... Perhaps this could be useful 
on courses where races tend to play out 
like that.
